title: Sources
description: Every data source that records in the dataset cite through source_ids. Also drives the attribution page.

sources.description: All sources, sorted by id. IDs must be unique; JSON Schema can't check uniqueness by field, so producers and tests must.

source.title: Source
source.description: One data source, such as a registry snapshot or a photo archive.

id.description: Stable ID referenced by source_ids. Snapshot-based sources include the month (e.g. opensky-2026-08).

url.description: Where the data can be found, or null for sources with no public location (e.g. manual overrides).

license.description: License or terms the data is used under, or null when it varies per record (e.g. Wikimedia Commons photos, whose licenses are on each imageRef).

retrieved_at.description: When the data was downloaded, or null for sources that aren't downloaded (e.g. manual overrides).
